The mayor hands you a fallow plot and **{coins}**.

Sow, harvest, sell, then do it again, bigger.

To get going:
`/plant seed:Wheat`: sow
`/farm`: see your plots
`/harvest`: bring it in

Stuck? `/help` has the answers, `/tutorial` walks you through.

help.title: 🌾 Harvester help
help.intro: Harvester is a farming game: plant, raise, process, sell.
help.tips_value:
• Weather is shared by the whole village: on rainy days, watering is free.
• Market prices fall when everyone sells the same thing.
• A co-op grants permanent bonuses to all its members.

step1.title: 1/6 · Planting
step1.body:
Everything starts with a seed.

`/plant seed:Wheat`

Without a plot number, the bot fills your empty plots automatically. Add `quantity:9` to sow them all at once.

step2.title: 2/6 · Watering
step2.body:
Every crop expects one or more waterings while it grows.

`/water`

A missed watering costs 8% of the yield (up to −40%). On rainy days, it's free.

step3.title: 3/6 · Harvesting
step3.body:
When a crop is ready, cash it in:

`/harvest`

Your harvest can come out Silver, Gold or Iridium: up to ×3 on the price. Good soil and quality fertilizer improve your odds.

step4.title: 4/6 · Selling
step4.body:
The village buys everything:

`/sell item:Wheat quantity:all`

Prices move every hour with what other players sell: check `/market` before dumping stock.

step5.title: 5/6 · Reinvesting
step5.body:
Your coins are there to grow:

• `/buy-plot`: one more plot
• `/shop`: seeds, fertilizer, tools
• `/buildings`: coop, mill, warehouse
• `/buy-animal`: passive production

step6.title: 6/6 · Progressing
step6.body:
Every day:

• `/daily`: daily reward and streak
• `/quests`: 4 daily quests + 3 weekly
• `/coop`: join a co-op for permanent bonuses
